name: gauntlet-loop
facts: The lead writes a delegation contract for one piece; a builder subagent produces the artifact and its evidence
A fresh critic audits the artifact against the answer key and receives neither the builder's rationale nor any prior critic's notes
A win or a tie passes and the evidence is logged; a loss returns exactly one gap, which becomes the next contract
No round count appears anywhere in the loop; the human is the stop condition
budget_cuts: the ledger folded into the PASSED sublabel rather than drawn as a seventh node
the fresh-context boundary drawn as the focal border plus a callout rather than as a zone
